name: Fion
source:
Fion is a young, put-upon lass from a huge family, who works hard to ensure all her brothers and sisters have enough food to eat. At least, that’s what she says, but Neve isn’t entirely convinced.

Fion might look like a sweet, innocent thing, looks can be deceiving, and she’s far craftier than she initially appears.
